secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<ref>.supabase.co). Used by the API server for auth + data via the Supabase REST API. Find it in your Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key. Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > anon public key. Used for client-facing REST calls.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role secret key. Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > service_role secret. Used for privileged admin REST calls.
